from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import csv, json, hashlib, math, statistics
root = Path('/home/eric/wjg/wd/csdecomp')
out = root / 'reproduction/reports/paper_constructed'
review = dict(schema_version=1, recorded_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), scope='Read-only arithmetic and interpretation review of saved 400+400-case results. No planning, solver, geometry or GPU calls. Does not replace independent geometry or resume audit.', checks=[], issues=[], evidence_sha256={}, families={})
def evidence(p):
    p = Path(p)
    review['evidence_sha256'][str(p.relative_to(root))] = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return p

def read(p):
    return json.loads(evidence(p).read_text())

def csvread(p):
    return list(csv.DictReader(evidence(p).open()))

def check(label, actual, expected):
    numeric = isinstance(actual, (int, float)) and isinstance(expected, (int, float))
    ok = math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-10, abs_tol=1e-10) if numeric else actual == expected
    review['checks'].append(dict(check=label, passed=ok, actual=actual, expected=expected))
    if not ok:
        review['issues'].append(label)

def stats(values):
    return dict(n=len(values), mean=statistics.mean(values) if values else None,
                sd_ddof1=statistics.stdev(values) if len(values)>1 else None,
                min=min(values) if values else None, median=statistics.median(values) if values else None,
                max=max(values) if values else None)

for family in ['forest', 'fr3']:
    p = out / family
    s, rows, jobs = read(p/'summary.json'), csvread(p/'methods.csv'), csvread(p/'jobs.csv')

    run = Path(s['run_dir'])
    manifest = read(run/'manifest.json')
    info = dict(run_dir=str(run), requested=s['requested'], native_drm_successes=s['native_drm_successes'], strict_seed_valid=s['strict_seed_valid'], manifest_status=manifest['status'], case_status_counts=dict(Counter(r['status'] for r in jobs)), methods={}, collision_depths={}, selected_failure_records=[])
    for name, actual, expected in [
        ('unique case-method records', len({(r['id'],r['method']) for r in rows}), 2000),
        ('method records', len(rows), 2000), ('unique cases', len({r['id'] for r in jobs}), 400),
        ('manifest cases', len(manifest['cases']), 400),
        ('DRM count', sum(r['drm_success']=='True' for r in jobs), s['native_drm_successes']),
        ('strict seed count', sum(r['strict_seed_valid']=='True' for r in jobs), s['strict_seed_valid']),
        ('case status counts', info['case_status_counts'], s['case_status_counts']),
        ('source issues', s['source_integrity_issues'], []), ('artifact issues', s['artifact_issues'], [])]:
        check(family+': '+name, actual, expected)

        values.update(validated_rate_requested=len(passed)/len(a), validated_rate_given_native_drm=len(passed)/len(native), validated_rate_given_valid_seed=sum(r['strict_seed_valid']=='True' for r in passed)/len(validseed), solver_success_rate_given_native_drm=sum(r['solver_success']=='True' for r in native)/len(native), native_cuda_cfr_given_drm=sum(r['native_cuda_collision_free']=='True' for r in native)/len(native), total_ms_mean_all_attempts=statistics.mean(float(r['total_ms']) for r in timed), total_ms_sd_all_attempts=statistics.stdev(float(r['total_ms']) for r in timed), cost_mean_solver_success=statistics.mean(float(r['cost']) for r in solver if r['cost']), cost_mean_validated=statistics.mean(float(r['cost']) for r in passed if r['cost']))

                info['selected_failure_records'].append(dict(case_id=r['id'], method=method, status=r['status'], reason=r['reason'], validation=v, traceback=record.get('traceback')))
    for method in ['NTO_distance', 'NTO_time']:
        d = [r for r in depth if r['method']==method]
        groups = {}
        for status in ['all', 'validation_failed', 'optimization_failed', 'success_numerical', 'not_run']:
